policy: Use supplied textbook terminology for confirmed matching technical senses in lessons, questions, choices, reasons, glossary and captions.
Retain 2026 Japanese knowledge, current source hashes, numeric examples and all conditions; older source is a terminology authority only.
Do not conflate 管理基準 with 許容限界(CL) or OL in 2号; do not conflate 改善措置, 修正 and 是正処置.
Preserve clinical breadth, scientific organism names, generic prose and context. Do not propagate corrupt PDF text layers.
New translations or edits must consult the locale inventory and context exceptions in the accompanying audit.
Locales without supplied references are deferred; zh-CN is not automatic authority for zh-TW.
